register_oid_dataset: register an OID instances dataset to the Detectron2 DatasetCatalog with a COCO JSON file and image root path
load_coco_json: load a COCO format JSON annotation file and return a list of dataset dicts with image records and annotations
map_category_ids: map non-contiguous category IDs from a COCO JSON file to contiguous IDs starting from zero for the dataset metadata
filter_invalid_polygons: filter out invalid polygon segmentations with fewer than 3 points when loading COCO annotation data
handle_neg_category_ids: handle negative category IDs in image metadata by mapping them through the dataset's contiguous ID mapping
